1035. Food Delivery Path Optimization

70

Hard

Problem Statement:
Create a food delivering system which allocates the path for delivery of food using appropriate data structures.
input_spec:
The first line of the input is the two space-separated integers N and M denoting the size of the sample space.

It is followed N rows and M column matrix denoting the time weightage of each route points in minutes to move from given (nx, mx) to (ny, mx).

The last line of the input contains space-separated co-ordinate values indicating the source and destination in the following format:

ns,ms nd,md

Note: The movements can be made only in top, left, right and bottom directions
output_spec: Print the shortest time to reach the destination
